svg.title: web-03 Payroll pre-export review (Agency Web App)
svg.desc: Low-fidelity wireframe of the payroll pre-export review for the bi-weekly period 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-13: summary tiles, a list of three acknowledged pre-export blockers, a caregiver summary for workweek 2, the canonical pay-line breakdown for Maya Ortiz totalling $958.59, and the Export and lock panel with its confirmation note. Numbered callouts 1 to 9.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Resolve each item or acknowledge it. Excluded hours move to the next
open period as adjustment lines once the visit is Verified.
Watermark in file name and export manifest; SHA-256 recorded.
Exporting locks 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-13. Later changes become
adjustment lines in the next open period (2026-09-14 to 2026-09-27).
3 acknowledged blockers: 5.52 h carried forward once Verified.
I understand this period will be locked.
Hourly $19.50 effective 2026-01-01; overtime, holiday and mileage eligible
No minute is paid at both the holiday and overtime rates (higher multiplier only).
